incident-bot: PAGED: PagerDuty alert fired -> EMBEDS_5XX_RATE for embeddings-service (eu1). Pager: rotation-oncall, see PD link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345. Auto-ack required. @alex g on rotation.

alex g: taking this. starting triage now — do we have customer-facing errors or just internal 5xx?

jamal r: seeing spike of 502/504 from eu1 after 12:01 UTC. noisy ingress from a few clients. sample logs:```
2026-03-15T12:01:07Z ERROR embed-worker request_id=xyz status=502 downstream=grpc://model-v1 message="kv-cache timeout"
2026-03-15T12:01:12Z ERROR embed-worker request_id=abc status=504 downstream=quant-runner message="kernel OOM"
```

maria p: I can try increasing dedicated pool replicas as a short-term mitigation. Suggest bump from 3 -> 6 and route noisy traffic to fallback model.

alex g: go ahead. also check autoscaler logs — if quota or region limits are blocking scaling we need fallback. jamal, can you confirm autoscaler status?

jamal r: autoscaler shows scale-up attempts failing due to GPU quota exhaustion in eu-west-1. Queue length high, continuous batching backlog rising. I'm going to implement a traffic split: 10% -> embed-small (quantized) and enable edge rate-shedding for top offending clients. Applying config now:```
# route split example (pseudo)
PATCH /services/embeddings/routing
{ "route": [ {"model":"embed-small","weight":0.10}, {"model":"embed-v1","weight":0.90} ] }
```

alex g: approved, do it. and add a temporary per-client throttle rule: ```rate-limit: 60/min per-api-key``` push and report back.

maria p: pushed routing changes and rate-limit. 10% to embed-small, enforced per-key throttle for top offending keys. Applying now. :rocket:

ops-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: routing/embeddings -> applied by maria p. rate-limits updated.

jamal r: already seeing improvement in error rate — 5xx rate dropped ~78% -> ~18% within 90s. queues shrinking. CPU on embed pool down from 92% -> 65%.

alex g: good. customer impact summary? ops-bot, any support tickets coming in?

ops-bot: CUSTOMER IMPACT: 24 support incidents flagged as degraded performance (higher latency), no data loss or corruption reported. Created support ticket JOURNAL-12345 and notified Top 5 customers.

sre-runbooks: I've kicked off quota request to cloud provider for temporary GPU bump (request ID Q-9876). ETA ~25 minutes. If granted we can scale back to primary model and remove fallback traffic.

alex g: ack. We'll keep incident open for monitoring and hand off if stable. maria, can you own the post-incident review if we remain stable at T+30?

maria p: ack — I'll gather traces, prompt sets, and eval diffs. I'll also check whether quantized fallback produced any quality regressions for sampled requests.

jamal r: leaving one mitigation note: we should add a quick autoscale healthcheck to detect quota failures and automatically shift routing to quantized variants next time. I'll draft a change.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Page auto-acked by alex g. Current status: MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Suppressing duplicate alerts for 10m.

alex g: monitoring for 20 more minutes, will update at +10 and +20. If everything stays green I'll hand to maria for postmortem.

maria p: copied — will start collecting artifacts now. please add any additional logs or client API keys that hit throttles.

ops-bot: NOTE: Support notified customers and posted status update to status.redwood.example. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes unless resolved.

alex g: thanks team. good quick coordination. keeping channel open for pings.

incident-bot: THREAD NOTE: last state change -> mitigation applied. Closing follow-up alerts suppressed until 3099990615.
